blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Spikers’ Turf finally experienced the breakthrough support that the men’s volleyball players have long desired as the league celebrated its 10th anniversary with the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) before a record crowd at SM Seaside Cebu Arena on Saturday. With the Spikers’ Turf sharing the spotlight with the PVL in their 10th season, Alpha Insurance and Savouge didn’t disappoint the 13,180 fans–the most-watched men’s game so far—with the Protectors eking out a thrilling 25-22, 19-25, 26-24, 22-25, 16-14 win to kick off the Invitational Conference.
